panels.description: IPs banned via subscribed third-party blocklists

panels.description: Bans issued by this engine's own scenarios

panels.title: Active bans (local decisions)
panels.description: Bans triggered by this engine (scenarios, AppSec, manual cscli), live from the local API. Community and third-party blocklist bans are counted in the Decisions row instead

panels.title: Active decisions by origin
panels.description: CAPI = community blocklist, lists = subscribed blocklists, crowdsec = local scenarios

panels.title: Blocklists
panels.description: Active bans per subscribed blocklist

panels.title: Alerts by scenario (stored)
panels.description: Alerts currently stored in the local database, per scenario. Old alerts are pruned by the flush policy

panels.title: Alert activity
panels.description: New alerts over time. Database pruning no longer shows up as fake spikes

panels.title: Recent alerts (24h)
panels.description: Alerts raised in the last 24h, live from the local API, with the request path that triggered them

panels.title: Inband p95 latency
panels.description: Added request latency from inline AppSec inspection over the dashboard time range

panels.title: AppSec rule hits
panels.description: Triggered AppSec rules; inband rules block inline, out-of-band rules only alert

panels.title: Whitelist hits
panels.description: Events dropped by whitelists before reaching scenarios. The private ipv4/ipv6 whitelist currently swallows all file-acquired events because rootlessport masks client IPs; expected to fix itself once pasta port forwarding lands (podman 6.0)

panels.title: Live buckets by scenario
panels.description: Scenario state machines currently tracking a source; a bucket that overflows raises an alert

panels.title: Bouncer requests
panels.description: Remediation components pulling decisions; a flatline means the bouncer stopped enforcing

panels.title: Empty decision pulls (24h)
panels.description: Bouncer decision pulls that returned no result; normal when nothing changed

panels.title: PAPI last pull
panels.description: Polling API delivers centrally-managed decisions; Never is expected without a console enrollment that pushes them

panels.title: File descriptor usage
panels.description: Open file descriptors as a share of the process limit
